# Sillage Égypte — Extended Reference

Sillage Égypte is a private, luxury-tier tour operator designing bespoke journeys
across Egypt for discerning international travellers. All journeys are fully
private (no shared groups), led by certified Egyptologists and specialists, and
built around each traveller's interests, pace, and time. Primary markets: Europe,
North America, and Japan. Guiding languages: English, Arabic, French, Japanese.
Website: https://sillage-egypte.com — Contact: hello@sillage-egypte.com

## How we work

Every journey begins with a conversation, not a booking engine. A traveller
submits an enquiry; a journey designer replies within 24 hours and prepares a
private, no-obligation proposal, refined until it is exactly right. Pricing is
individual to each journey's length, accommodation standard, and included
experiences.

## Journeys

Each is a private starting framework, tailored to the traveller.

### Cairo, Two Views — 4 days
https://sillage-egypte.com/tours/cairo-two-views
Three nights in Cairo between the Nile and the Pyramids — Giza, Saqqara and Dahshur, the Grand Egyptian Museum, and a felucca at dusk.

### Egypt in Brief — 6 days
https://sillage-egypte.com/tours/egypt-in-brief
Cairo and Luxor seen properly — the pyramids, the museum, and the temples and royal tombs of Thebes.

### The Grand Tour — 10 days
https://sillage-egypte.com/tours/grand-tour
Cairo, a night beside the temples of Abu Simbel, Aswan and three unhurried days in Luxor, staying in the great houses of the Nile.

### The Complete Egypt — 13 days
https://sillage-egypte.com/tours/complete-egypt
Cairo, Luxor, five nights under sail on a dahabiya, Aswan and Abu Simbel, with the Pyramids held for the end.

### The Nile & the Red Sea — 13 days
https://sillage-egypte.com/tours/nile-red-sea
Cairo, the Pyramids and the Nile temples by luxury cruiser, then four unhurried days on the Red Sea.

### Christmas & New Year on the Nile — 14 days
https://sillage-egypte.com/tours/christmas-new-year-nile
21 December 2026 to 3 January 2027 — Christmas under sail on a chartered dahabiya, New Year in Aswan, Abu Simbel at dawn.

### Beyond the Nile — 16 days
https://sillage-egypte.com/tours/beyond-the-nile
Cairo, Alexandria, Siwa and the Great Sand Sea, then six nights down the Nile by cruiser to Luxor, by way of Abu Simbel.

- Sharm el-Sheikh (the Sinai coast) — https://sillage-egypte.com/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh

## Experiences

Single signature moments that can be built into any journey.

- The Empty Plateau (Giza) — Two hours on the Giza plateau for your party alone, subject to official permission for the date. https://sillage-egypte.com/experiences/the-empty-plateau
- The Empty Museum (Grand Egyptian Museum) — Two hours in the museum outside public hours, including the complete Tutankhamun collection. https://sillage-egypte.com/experiences/the-empty-museum
- The Temple by River (Luxor & Dendera) — A day's sail north from Luxor to the Temple of Hathor at Dendera. https://sillage-egypte.com/experiences/the-temple-by-river
- The Salt Lakes (Siwa) — Floating in the hypersaline turquoise pools of Siwa, timed to the late light. https://sillage-egypte.com/experiences/the-salt-lakes
- Tea on the Terrace (Aswan) — Afternoon tea above the Nile, overlooking Elephantine Island. https://sillage-egypte.com/experiences/tea-on-the-terrace
- Lunch Under Sail (Cairo) — Two hours on a private felucca on the Nile in Cairo, with an Egyptian lunch aboard. https://sillage-egypte.com/experiences/lunch-under-sail

## Guides

- Dr. Azmy Salama — Egyptologist, archaeologist and private guide; specialist in Saqqara, Memphis, Dahshur, Giza and the Old Kingdom.
- Mohamed Sayed Elhelw — Spanish-speaking Egyptian tour guide with more than 26 years of experience; Egyptian history, archaeology and culture.
  Languages: Spanish.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What does Sillage Égypte offer?
A: Fully private tours across Egypt — Nile journeys, desert and oasis
expeditions, and ancient-site immersion in Cairo and Luxor. Every tour is
designed exclusively for the traveller, with no shared groups.

Q: Who are the tours designed for?
A: International travellers (chiefly Europe, North America, Japan) who want
depth, expert knowledge, and total privacy.

Q: Are all tours private?
A: Yes. There are no shared group departures.

Q: How do I book?
A: Submit the Plan Your Journey form; a journey designer replies within 24 hours
to start a private proposal.

Q: What destinations are covered?
A: Cairo and the Pyramids, Luxor and the Valley of the Kings, Aswan and Abu
Simbel, the Nile between them, Alexandria, Siwa Oasis, and the Red Sea and Sinai
coasts — with private access to sites off standard routes.

Q: How much does a private Egypt tour cost?
A: Pricing is individual to each journey. A clear, no-obligation proposal follows
an initial conversation. Sillage Égypte is a luxury-tier operator.
